note: Indicative warning bands for standard passenger-car speeding violations in Switzerland. Fixed fines come from the federal Ordnungsbussenverordnung SR 314.11 item 303 after ASTRA measurement/safety deduction. The current app schema has urban/rural variants only, so motorway-specific fines and withdrawal thresholds are included in detail text.

At least 3 months licence withdrawal risk. Case may trigger criminal/report handling and high fees.
Severe report handling likely. Raser threshold is posted-limit dependent and begins at +40 km/h only where the posted limit is 30 km/h or lower.

Raser-level threshold is generally reached at +80 km/h on roads posted above 80 km/h, with criminal, vehicle and long licence-withdrawal risk.
